reviews.text: DO NOT PURCHASE PREMIUM. In all fairness, the app itself is good. However, if you purchase the premium subscription you won’t be able to cancel it if you choose. I have been trying to cancel my paid subscription for months, and my emails have gone unanswered. And they charged me my next annual fee, even after requesting to cancel. It seems I will have to take it up with my credit card company now to deny any future payment and to see if they can go after them for charging me for services I no longer want. Unprofessional and beyond terrible customer service. Fraudulent even?

Not for beginners. There aren’t videos that are for the very initial beginner that take you slowly through a series of yoga movements (tell you how to get into the pose, what you should feel and where you should feel the stretch, talk you through alternatives to the pose while staying in the pose then slowly taking you into the next pose). You’re either going through poses in isolation or you’re going through various flows and rushing to the next pose. Tried to get my husband to do something labeled “beginner” and even though I’ve been doing yoga for several yrs I had a difficult time keeping up.

Glitches - App won’t open unless deleted and reinstalled every use. The app works when you first download and open it, but after you close the app it will not open. Only a white screen shows and an error message comes up. I deleted the app, reinstalled it and same thing happened. I’ve tried this 3 times and now only use the online website.

Worth repeating. I find I keep coming back to the Men’s 30 Day Workout. Raganthe can wear you out in ten minutes. There other yoga routines I use but this 30 day plan is my home base.

DoYouYoga is a great app.

App keeps crashing everyday. Currently the app crashes once a day and constantly needs to be uninstalled/reinstalled daily to work :( I keep doing it bc I otherwise love free sessions, but it’s definitely a pain.

Jumping back in. I came back to Yoga after 3 yrs of Covid wrecking havoc to my body

Partially my fault and a little bit of Covid lockdowns 

Lost my yoga studio and classes which broke my 4 day a weak practice 
Goal is to ease consistently back into a good practice that will ease my pains, balance my body and put me on a lifelong track w Yoga

Ragunath is really educated and doesn’t beat you up for trying
Fav app 4th year in a row. Few apps have the pose library the way DOYOU does. And lots of yoga routines to get to the poses you most desire. Love the app!! (Fav instructors: Kristen, Katie, Faith)
Price increase. The yearly membership jumped from 79 to 179. I can understand that all prices go up but an over 100% increase takes the cake
App keeps crashing. Fix this please The app keeps crashing
THIS APP IS BROKEN PLZ FIX. EVERYtime I open app it’s just a white blank screen
Really simple and great app. The title says it all. I love the simple interface and easy of navigation. Helps keep me motivated everyday! You all are doing great. I appreciate you!
App organization is a little wonky. It would be nice to see everything and be able to filter based on instructor, style, length, and skill level. You can search for things, but it’s difficult

Great app but ignored my emails. Ok first I’d like to say they app is amazing the content is amazing. Best yoga app for yoga. Jess was amazing I mostly watched her stuff. But…. I tried to cancel last year by sending an email but they didn’t cancel no big deal maybe I didn’t. Ok. Started yoga again. then last month I sent an email stating I wanted to cancel. 35 days no response. The credit card was paid and canceled trying to lower my debit. Then I get multiple emails a day stating my card didn’t go through for like a week. Please add a different card. Sent a response to both the email from the site and that email stating I had canceled. Still no response. After multiple emails attempting to charge that card I finally removed authorization from them through pay pal. Now no more attempts. This is terrible customer service and a grimy way to attempt to keep money coming in. Bad business. I will never become a member of do u ever again and be aware of this bad business practice. Be surprised if they keep this up due to the review.
Great app!. They have a wonderful variety of classes! The app makes completing your practice accessible any time.

There is no way to unsubscribe from this app. This app is a scam. You sign up for the free trial but there is no way to unsubscribe, either on the app or the website. All they give you is an email address that no one responds to. These people are charging my card without permission and stealing from me!!
Thank you:). First day of my free yoga class completed! You made it quite doable and were very encouraging. Perfect amount of time without me getting discouraged like I always have before. Thank you!

Great Site Great App. I have been using do you yoga for years now. It was foundational to the beginning of my practice. Now that is available as an application, it’s even easier for me to do guided sessions. There are a massive variety of classes so I never run out of things to try.I would recommend it to anybody who is just getting started or who already may be familiar with the practice of yoga.

Love this app but….. I like this program. The woman’s voice is soothing and she is a joy to listen to. My complaint is that I have been trying to buy the program while I’m doing my 30 day free trial and the links don’t work. I have been trying for a week and there seems to be no way to upgrade. Hoping they fix it before I find another program
Day 2. Lovely stretches! Thank you
Yoga. Best yoga at ❤️

Consistency. I love an app that tracks consistency. The calendar is amazing! Plus you can look back & see your practice history & favorites section especially if you really liked a session and wish to repeat it. The best part is that it’s easy to narrow down which practice you wish to achieve at the time that you’re sitting down on your mat time constraint wise, energy level wise, goal wise, and even a specific teacher if you so wish. I love it!

Is this app a scam?. I purchased the Lifetime Premium Pass for $97, but I have not been able to create an account, use the content or get anyone from this company’s customer service/support to respond to any of my emails requesting assistance. Is this app a scam? Should I dispute the charge to get a refund? Please help!
*****UPDATE TO ORIGINAL REVIEW*******
A member of the DoYou team has contacted me and I’m able to use the app now.

Great app and service support. I’ve been using DOYOU for many years now. The website, the app, and the service support has all been great since the very beginning. 
I really recommend DOYOU for yoga and meditation daily implementation.

Day 1. Done successfully!

Feel awesome!!!
I have been a member for years now. Such a great resource, they run annual membership specials and are always working to improve the experience. My go to at home yoga app and yoga is my favorite
Doyouyaga. I love this website! It gives me everything I need even when I haven’t gotten a subscription to it☺️😊👍😁😁

Do You Yoga. The app for Do You is easy to navigate. It’s options to rate each session is intuitive. The feature that is NOT user friendly is when a non premium user is led to believe a session is available only to start it but then be unable to continue through to the end.
Fantastic. Awesome app and program. 100% worth the subscription

Fantastic, best I’ve found.. I haven’t paid for this yet but I’m going to. I’ve tried a lot of yoga apps and this one by far is the best. They combine breathing and meditation with the stretching which is what yoga is all about! I also like that as you go your reminded to flex or relax certain parts of your body to avoid injury. Just great over all and I’m still in free mode!
Great app. I love this app for yoga!
Amazing. This app is the only way I’ve done yoga for years and when I go to classes in studios I miss what I have going on with this app

Cardio 9 min yoga. Excellent! Instructor very easy to follow, strong and encouraging. Careful to remind us to find balance and work at a workable and challenging level for each of us. Also great at making us feel accomplished no matter how much we did..or didn’t do.

Best Little Yoga App Ever. I can’t say enough about these short, doable, inspiring yoga sessions in the 30-day challenge! I love Jess and look forward to 10-20 minutes of her gentle and compassionate friendship every morning. Please try it! You won’t be sorry.
Great Yoga. Has kept me interested for the last year! I love the practice!
Thanks. Wonderful way to start the day after Waking Up meditation

It’s good, but.... I’ve been using DoYouYoga since 2017/2018, starting back with Katy’s classes for splits. As a free member, I was really happy with the content and being able to access it through my laptop and app. I did upgrade to Premium and am still happy with it, even though I really only do Katy Scherer’s classes. I have tried other apps, and DoYou is one of the cleaner, easy to navigate apps I’ve tried. There’s also diversity in teachers, styles and practices, although on the whole the teachers aren’t as diverse as some of the other options out there. 

As some other people have mentioned, the app/website stop being user friendly when you’re attempting to cancel your subscription, or even if you’re just looking for subscription information. It is a great price point though. There is a community online for those premium members, but everything seems to be focused on getting fit/weight loss. If that sort of diet and wellness culture is what you’re into then it really is the app for you. But if that’s not what you’re wanting, then maybe use a different app or relegate yourself to one or two teachers.

LOVE!!. Love this app!! After trying a few different yoga apps, I’ve been using DOYOU for about 2 years now. Love the teachers, love the sessions and all the different types of yoga offered. Although I enjoy many of the different teachers, Jess Rose is my go to daily teacher, I just love her classes she explains how to get into positions where I can understand and goes at a perfect pace for me, she’s fun and silly and I always feel amazing after a session with her. Not to mention I’ve made amazing progress in my own practice all thanks to DOYOU. I recommend this app to all my fellow yogis♥️
Love DOYOU. I love this yoga as a beginner it’s easy to follow but no matter what level you are they have you covered!

Variety of Practices. The variety of practices make this a great way to find a great fit for your yoga journey. 
I practice w several instructors, but my favorite instructor is Richardia! I love her calming strength and spiritual practice. I am sure you can find a great fit for yourself!
Fantastic. The feeling after the first session was enough for me. Instructor is great and really helps to let go of yourself. Great so far, you should really just do it for yourself.
So many choices!. Tons of variety. Something for every mood/need.
i’ve tried a lot of yoga apps. & doyou is the best!! the instructors make me come back everyday!!
Love it. Just had my first beginners session and I feel awesome. This app was the perfect way to get started

Sense of accomplishment. The pandemic with a surgery in the middle and my 63rd birthday made me feel like my yoga days were coming to an end. I like the way Dan leads into higher levels of work that not only helped me do a little more than I thought I could, but also let me hang out at a moderate intensity but aspiring to do more over time. Thanks for helping me discover I still can come back.
I love this... I had a moment of peace
Love her energy!. I love practicing with her! She’s my favorite!
Intention setting. Loved this session!
LOVE IT!!!. Great quick stretch, with uplifting life philosophy to boot!
Balance. I feel so balanced after doing each of these classes. It’s a great practice to start your day to help keep you centered and content.

Good overall. Casting to my Samsung TV is not working. I granted the permission in iOS settings and then the cast button disappeared from the videos. 

Other than that, the app is great!

Great resource, platform could use some features. A great variety of videos and teachers. I wish you could sort and filter by duration and experience level. I also wish you could make personal playlists. Right now you can only “favorite” videos.

Best Yoga App!. Amazing app! It reintroduced my love for yoga. There are classes for beginners to advanced with a variety of session times. On days I don’t have much time to workout I look forward to quick 10 minute sessions with the instructor Jess to clear my head. Highly recommend!
Love It!. I love the Yoga Shred. I get a workout in 20 minutes! The cool-downs are great, too. 10/10!

Best yoga app I have come across!. I have gone through many yoga apps and this one was by far the best. I believe it’s because of some of the main yoga instructors they have on the app.I really enjoy the how to videos and the pace for beginners all the way up to advance. I was even willing to pay for the year app because I loved it so much.
I love Do You Yoga!. I love doing yoga with Jess, I feel like I learn so much and I get a good workout at the same time! I also love to meditate with Faith Hunter, bring on the calm!!

Very helpful!. I’ve had DOYOU.com on my phone for over a year. I’ve only been accessing the free content so far, which has been great! If I had the extra income, I would go premium, but the basic is sufficient. The instructors are quality & I like the variety.
The best yoga. I love this app so much I can do all different kinds of challenges and I feel so great
Great App for yoga classes!. I love doing yoga at home, whenever it is convenient for me. There are plenty of free classes to keep you going!

DOYOU. I am really a fan of all the DOYOU apps. I started with yoga and had such a good experience I tried out Barre, HIIT and the 7 minute workout. They are easy to follow and are challenging at the same time. I recommend these apps to everyone!
Best yoga app. I’ve been using the app for years but about 7 months ago really started to take it to the next step every instructor I’ve used have been knowledgeable and great teachers
Great app. Never disappointed
Nice and peaceful. Several meditations I’ve done in the last, the instructor would do a lot of talking. Faith talked enough to guide your relaxation without distracting you from your meditation.
Great. Great!

Network permission issue. App now says it required network permissions for chromecast but unfortunately does not give you the ability to change them. Chromecast functionality now broken with newest iOS.

Just Don’t. This might have okay yoga videos but when you need to contact customer service over your account - good luck. When I wanted to cancel my subscription because I don’t do yoga enough to justify this membership I got dead air. When I continued to email them about canceling my membership through the email address they tell you to contact - I have received zero replies. DO NOT buy into this program they’ll take your money and then refuse to accept that you want to end your business with them.

Be patient. Paid for a full year of premium service up front, but wasn’t able to access the premium content after 30 days. While it took a little longer than I liked getting a response, in reality it was within an acceptable time frame, and a resolution was quick, thank you, Jan. About 1.5 business days total. All said and done, the content and interface are amazing! I’d love to see an app for smart TVs such as Roku, or FireTV as well. But overall, I recommend highly.
Where’s the landscape orientation for iPad?. Hi there! I just signed up for your premium version and was sad to find no landscape orientation for iPad. Any plans for this in the near future? Thanks!

NO Response in membership cancellation. I tried sending 3 emails in the past week to cancel my subscription and I have not received any email to follow up on this. Have not heard anything from your customer service team.

It’s great but videos don’t load properly. I love Doyouyoga, it’s really advanced my yoga practice and really gives me no excuse to not practice!
However as of recent the videos don’t play in the app and I haven’t been able to practice unless I’m on my laptop which I don’t always have handy! would love to see this fixed

Stuck at login page.. I can use the app. It’s stuck on the login page.
I have an iPhone Xs. Fairly new phone. 
i’ve Tried reset the password a few times and nothing. 
I guess I’ll never know if the app is good...
Can’t open. I have yet to get past the screen where it tells me it’s loading. Don’t even know if this app might be great or not...

Could be useful but sketchy. The app is well organized and could be beneficial if you don’t need to learn yoga in a classroom setting. 

Having said that, I signed up for the 7 day trial but realized on day six that it wasn’t for me. I went to the website to cancel my subscription and I was told to email them my request so I did and that was that. The next day I was charged for the one year membership. I’ve been all over the place to get a refund, but they refuse to respond to my inquiries. 

All in all, I’m out $80 on a membership I’m never going to use. If you feel like it’s for you the app is helpful and the prices aren’t that bad but if you try the trial be sure you know you have cancelled your subscription should you not want to be billed.

Amazing!. All I can say is, WOW! I don’t usually leave reviews, but I have to for this program. I just started using Do You Yoga and I love it! Lots of great, high quality content! Please try it!!! You will not be disappointed. I’m currently doing the 28 day beginner yoga, 30 day meditation challenge and the 9 day beginner splits. The instructors are wonderful and give step by step guidance the entire time, I never feel like I am lost. Seriously, try it out!

Raghunath is Fantastic, do his 30 day men’s yoga challenge. Been asked to do yoga by my wife for 20 years. Started do some a few years ago to recover from getting old and still being super active. Raghunath is no touchy feely yogi, great messages, great messenger and the yoga is really good. You will laugh and be inspired. Thanks DYY and Raghunath!!!

Pretty good. I love what I can access as a free user. The videos are nice and I like doing them. 

I would LOVE to see chromecast/ cast to screen capabilities added.

I would also love a sort feature that enables you to find the free videos easier. Having to scroll through all the paid to find them is not conducive to try before you buy mentality.

Love the site, app doesn’t work. I can’t afford the premium membership, but the free material is great...on the website. I was thrilled to get the app, but it logs me out anytime the phone times out. Even if I’d taken a moment away in between sessions!

Just trying the app. I love the app and all that it offers, but when I'm traveling, I often use it on my iPad vs my phone because the screen is bigger. I wish that it would automatically see the screen is horizontal instead of vertical and adjust accordingly. Otherwise everything seems fantastic. I just can't rate a half star more.

Smart casting. Hi, 
I love your application, I take my iPad with me when I travel and I live that I can take you wherever I go. One thing is whenever I am home and in my area of practice I would like to put you on a bigger screen. It would be nice to be able to smart cast tv’s or bigger devices if possible!
Good yoga app!. Pretty good app so far. Really like the programs they put together!
Perfect programs. Awesome teachers and clear stretching routines I learned how to do my splits and handstands
Awesome!. Absolutely loved it. The classes are great and it has helped me become consistent in my practice
Addicted. I started the splits in 9 days practice and I have fallen in love with it. It’s the highlight of my day now.
Good stuff. Just tried the new version. Really enjoying it so far
New Update. I loved this app before and after the update, it would’ve gotten 5 stars but since it updated the sound hasn’t been working. It only works with earphones please fix!! Thanks.

Awesome yoga app. This app is great for fitting in short, regular but super effective workouts into my weekly routine. Love the simplicity and being able to track my progress over time. Already seeing results!

Could be better. I love the Do You Yoga classic site & became a premium member because of all the great features this community provides. The app is reflective of their new site - which, in my opinion, is not as user friendly as their classic site. 

The app provides a lot of classes that are accessible on the desktop version - which I love. However, I cannot access the courses I am currently taking nor track my progress. I have to search for the instructor or the name of the course in order to continue - which can be difficult. 

Hopefully the app developers will continue to work on adding this feature. That would make the app extremely beneficial!
Logs me out?. I really like the web browser version of this but the app makes me mad because every time I open it, the app logs me out. Even if I’ve logged in earlier that day, it still logs me out.

Not as good as it could be. I got the app because I love the site... it doesn't live up. I'd like the same functionality available but the app is set up for something different. I would love to be able to actually search classes and access my profile from the app, but it doesn't allow that. I'd like to be able to take a specific class again while I'm away from home or without my laptop... it doesn't allow for that either. I'd like to be able to search by teacher... nope. Hard to get real usefulness out of this app.

Just trying the app. The app works nicely but I am new to Do You Yoga and had been using my computer all of last week. Now I'm out of town so I switched to my phone but my progress wasn't saved in my account and it seems really basic compared to the beautiful site. Perhaps it's in beta though, based on another reviewer mentioning a beta version. I can access all my videos and it's not a huge deal because I can still find the last video I was on. Still giving it 4 stars because I'm sure they'll be adding more and if I wasn't used to the site I would probably think it was perfect.

Welcome to a great Family. I have been beta testing for quite some time now and I love the DOYOUYOGA family! They are welcoming, helpful, and their classes are amazing. The app has been great to learn to use and experience since I really only can practice on the go! I don't have much time to do yoga either so I get the option of having a shorter class! The only that is wrong right now is the sync between their website and the app but that should be getting fixed pretty soon! I am very happy with this app!
Gets results. I've been using this app for a few weeks. It's easy to use, and gets results.

Varied yoga sessions. I used to really enjoy doing the yoga sessions but the new version of the app is definitely a backward step. I cannot understand why it has changed to a version that is not as good and some of the classes have disappeared. Thinking of finding something else

New app poor first impressions. Lost the ability to Chromecast to my TV. The photos of courses/classes are massive - one takes up my whole iPad screen so takes a huge amount of time to scroll through them. Does not seem to have the ability to search for classes/courses for name, only filter them. I have been a member for a few years and have loved the content, but disappointed with the new app.
yesYoga. Feel the difference after one session
Love hate. I love the sessions but the apis not great logs out crashes sooo frustrating
And relax. Enjoy the music and your voice feeling relaxed thanku Faith 😀

Incredible. Apologies completely forgot to redo my review but the app truly is amazing. It eases you into yoga so well no matter your skill level and usually I like to listen to music when I’m working out but with this and the guys voice guiding you it just feels like a friend guiding you. Keep it up! :)

My absolute favourite app. I love DoYou, I’ve been a member for a while now, but since lockdown I’ve done yoga or Pilates every single day. I love all types of yoga, especially Faith’s moving meditations, and Lacey’s yin classes, but I also like the quick classes from Jess and Katy’s stretch and balance classes. Sam’s Pilates with resistance bands is also great for me as a runner. THANK YOU.
Great app!. Like the variety of programs

Really enjoy doing DoYouYoga sequences.. I started with beginners challenges & it made doing yoga again a practical option for me. I’ve continued on with yearly membership, at my own pace & have several sequences on the go at once! 
There’s lots of choice for any level of ability & I have been able to find what suited my needs me best on the day each time I log in, almost daily now.
It’s been excellent value for money on each special offer. The instructors are easy to follow & keep up with.
I’ve recommended DoYouYoga to several people & ive found it better than attending classes.
DOYOU is Fantastic. It’s gradually got me into the daily habit of yoga and Pilates. My body has strengthened and improved considerably over the last 12 months. Thank you!

Do You app review. It’s great as you can search based on what you want and need for that session and work through programs that mean you develop your practice over time. Really helpful and high quality instruction.
Nice lessons. Nice lessons and some good free lessons. Most of it is only available with a subscription. 4 stars instead of 5 because is hard to find which lessons are free and which aren’t.

Brilliant app. I’ve been using this app for over a year now and can always find a yoga session to suit my mood. There are a lot of different lengths and styles to choose from. It’s also very easy to navigate. Will definitely continue to use daily.
Doyouyoga. Love this app. It is easy to use and suits all level of yogis. I also like the challenges and the fact that I can squeeze a yoga practice within my busy day

Not possible to register on App. I agree with one of the previous reviewers that it’s not easy (or possible it’s seems) to register to use the app, having subscribed.

Also, I haven’t received a confirmation email of my subscription so I don’t know how to unsubscribe! A bit dodgy given they now have my credit card details, on a monthly subscription plan. I’ll have to register it as an unauthorised payment with my credit card company to avoid future payments. Not ideal!

Great overall programme. Started off with the 30 days men’s yoga recommended by a friend, first time ever doing yoga, and it really got me hooked. Signed up now and their’s loads of great programmes for all different levels and types. Great variety.
Only thing I’d wish for was that the app could connect to Apple health so it would auto log my activity.

Shouting yoga instructor?. I love this application and the variety of programmes and sessions.

But.

I am sorry, but in a yoga session shouting doesn’t motivate me, at all. I understand Rhagunath’s enthusiasm and passion about endless possibilities in variations of some poses, but if he starts shouting, I think it is a huge NOPE.

After a long and tough workday, when you look forward to do your practice, build yourself back together, who wants to do workout with somebody who suddenly starts shouting and making you feel totally told off, and after realising, continues to speak still stressingly loud as well?

Not me. One boss like this is enough.

Nice idea but way too quick for a beginner. Signed up for the 30 day men’s yoga programme before thinking about subscribing. As a total beginner, it just seems like an ego trip for the rather overbearing instructor to see how many variations of poses he can show and how quickly he can do them. The feel is very unchilled and manic. There is no time at all to be able to see the next pose on the video before transition to the next. To me this does not seem constructively instructional and has completely put me off this programme. Sorry, but I will be looking for another app that is better paced for beginners.

Amazing App. I rarely ever do reviews but this app is literally changing my life. The videos really help and every video caters to what I want to focus on in yoga. This app really helps as a beginner in yoga and soon I’ll be paying for the membership - which I know will be amazing. I’ll definitely recommend this app to my friends! Keep it up!
Brilliant app for all level Yogis. favourite yoga app I have tried and Jess Rose is just fantastic thank you and namaste 🙏🏼 x
Amazing App. Like having your own private yoga lesson and personal yoga teacher with you all the time. Would recommend to anyone. So glad I bought this!
Perfectly great for beginners.. This is a good way to get into yoga, not only for beginners. Great free programs, and enjoyable teaching methods.
Decent. Really easy to use and offers great variety for a full home yoga practice or as an addition to a current studio practice
Rubbish. I pay for a premium account and the app won't let me log in - what's the point.
New content??. When will this app get new content? I’ve had a membership for two years and it’s still the same stuff, nothing new ever added. I won’t be renewing again.

My opinion of DOYOU. Most of the programs are very good and the instructor keep you motivated. Some of the programs are challenging while others are designed to help you relax and everything in between. I appreciate the work and effort that the doyou instructors put into their classes. Sincerely John McCormack
Good morning Pilates. A great session to get you stretched out and ready for the day.n or a good session after a workday.
Men’s 30 Day yoga challenge is great. Ragunath is an awesome instructor! Thank you for your help!
I love it. She is great

Thank you!. I’ve done several of the free programs over the years and last year decided I wanted to get the premium. It’s less than doing yoga classes for the year and I can base my practice on how I’m feeling that day. With the social distancing due to COVID19 I’ve found doing a daily session has helped keep me focused and active.

I like this app!. Just wanted to let other people from beginner to advance that this app is great and keeps you motivated by sending you weekly updates on your progress. There is so much variety too so if you want to sweat for 45 min or be lazy for 25 min or if you favour a certain instructor with a better connection than others you can choose. Sometimes the app has frozen and I had to pick a diff one but not often. Recommend paying the monthly fee though. You will be disappointed by the 28 day free offer.

No search function. There is no search bar to type in exactly what you’re looking for. The search option is a set of filters that get applied then spit out what the app thinks you want. Super frustrating. There are some great teachers affiliated with the product but they’re hard to find using the silly filters. Disappointing. I’m regretting paying for a membership.
Love the app. Really love the app and teachers, it would be even better if it could integrate with Apple Fitness!
Great app. But always crashes.. Not the greatest. But once I download it again (which is daily), then it’s actually really good.
Best Yoga App on the Market. And I should know. As one of the multitude of well intentioned yogis, I’ve always found a way to be inconsistent. Try this. You’ll know the difference from day 1.
Fabulous. Love Jess’ sense of humour shining through her teaching
Great app. Super easy to use, I always find the right type of session that I need! Plenty to choose from
Really easy and good to use. Great app that works well and is very simple and straightforward
Please add the ability to search by instructor!!. The search and filtering features of the app definitely some improvement. Being able to filter or search by instructor is key!!

Not as easy. I’m really missing the search function when using the app. It was much easy to manage my programs and search for a key area using the website. I expected the app profile could help keep track of where you were up to in programs. Personally I’m not interested in the badges and it seems a big focus in tracking.

Content is fantastic, app periodically crashes. I love DoYouYoga and have been using the web based program for quite some time. I recently downloaded the app and I find roughly 20 mins into a 30 minute program the app will log my session as complete and close. I love the content but it is disruptive to have to reopen the session and find my place again

Something for every level. I have been loving the do you yoga app. I completed the 30 day challenge which helped me get back in the habit of trying to stretch/ do small sessions of yoga every day. Next up I’ll be challenging myself trying out the handstand practice :)

Yoga on the go. I have been a user of the Do You Yoga site for a long time now and became a premium member because of the numerous diverse, great programs that are available. 
The teachers are top notch and the range of classes, for all levels, is immense and constantly growing
To be able to access all of this through the app at any time whist on the go is invaluable to those who like me must have their daily yoga fix.
The app is easy to use and I am happy to recommend it to anyone who is looking for an easy, all in one place, yoga smorgasbord
